Value.Value: Once again, we'll use the Source Element. This means that even if there are multiple messages displayed in the message bar, the close button will only be linked to the first warning message found, excluding other message types like warning or info.

First, locate the Message section and use the identified found element as the 'Source element' for the subsequent web element. This setup creates a one-to-one mapping, effectively linking them together.
